name: Pilbara Systems Internet
summary: WAIA member 2000; listed with WAIX as 'Pilbara Internet / Norcom'; site (pilbara.net.au, a dotnet dotau Pty Ltd service) went to a hosting default page Dec 2003, then Concept Networks 2004-06; domain later to Primus (ACN 086 757 011).

events.details: Regional WA ISP serving North West towns, late 1990s.
Site down Dec 2003; replaced by Concept Networks 2004-06.

refs.label: Own ISP brand site still served 12 Oct 2003.
Domain serving a different operator's branding by 31 Jan 2004.
Concept Networks (Apr 2006) and the Norcom redirect (Dec 2006) were successor tenants post-dating the Pilbara brand's death.
